text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎来到《简易英语》节目。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎來到《簡易英語》節目。

text: We're back with another conversation in Easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们回来继续用简易英语聊一聊，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 我們回來繼續用簡易英語聊一聊，幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Neil.
Don't forget that there's a video version of this podcast on our website,
zh: 别忘了这个播客在咱们网站上有视频版，
zh_hant: 別忘了這個播客在咱們網站上有影片版，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
You can read along with the subtitles and download a free worksheet.
zh: 你可以跟着字幕读，还能下载免费的练习表。
zh_hant: 你可以跟著字幕讀，還能下載免費的練習表。

text: Hello, Neil, how are you doing?
Hi, Georgie, yeah, I'm fine.
How are you?
Yes, I'm very well too, thank you.
Today, Neil, in this conversation, we're talking about moving house.
zh: 今天，尼尔，在这次对话里，咱们要聊聊搬家。
zh_hant: 今天，尼爾，在這次對話裡，咱們要聊聊搬家。

text: So, when was the last time you moved house?
zh: 那你上一次搬家是什么时候？
zh_hant: 那你上一次搬家是什麼時候？

text: Oh, I moved house probably 12 years ago.
Oh, wow.
And why did you move to where you live now?
zh: 那你为什么搬到现在住的地方？
zh_hant: 那你為什麼搬到現在住的地方？

text: Because my family was getting bigger.
zh: 因为我的家庭越来越大。
zh_hant: 因為我的家庭越來越大。

text: More children need more space,
zh: 孩子多了就需要更大的空间，
zh_hant: 孩子多了就需要更大的空間，

text: so we moved to somewhere bigger and further out of London.
zh: 所以我们搬到了一个更大、离伦敦更远的地方。
zh_hant: 所以我們搬到了一個更大、離倫敦更遠的地方。

text: How about you?
I rent my flat, and the place I was living before,
zh: 我现在租的是公寓，之前住的地方，
zh_hant: 我現在租的是公寓，之前住的地方，

text: the owners of the place wanted to sell the house,
so I needed to move because I couldn't live there anymore.
zh: 所以我得搬走，因为不能再住那儿了。
zh_hant: 所以我得搬走，因為不能再住那兒了。

text: And also, my friend had this flat
zh: 而且，我朋友正好有这套公寓，
zh_hant: 而且，我朋友正好有這套公寓，

text: and he was offering me very cheap rent,
so that's why I live there.
But I'm very happy there because it's between two really nice parks.
zh: 我住那儿挺开心，因为周围有两个很棒的公园。
zh_hant: 我住那兒挺開心，因為周圍有兩個很棒的公園。

text: It has good transport links.
And yeah, it was a good decision.
And how was the move itself?
The move was actually very easy
because I don't have many possessions.
I'm a bit of a minimalist.
The reason is because I moved country.
So I just didn't really have many things to bring back to the UK.
zh: 所以带回英国的东西真的不多。
zh_hant: 所以帶回英國的東西真的不多。

text: So I didn't need a big van or anything.
zh: 所以不需要大货车什么的。
zh_hant: 所以不需要大貨車什麼的。

text: I just ordered a taxi and put all of my bags in the taxi,
zh: 我就叫了辆出租车，把包都放进去，
zh_hant: 我就叫了輛計程車，把包都放進去，

text: and it was very easy.
And what about you?
It was the opposite of that.
Oh, no.
We had a removal van and some removal men
zh: 我们找了搬家公司的人和货车，
zh_hant: 我們找了搬家公司的人和貨車，

text: who came and packed everything up in boxes,
zh: 他们把东西都打包进箱子里，
zh_hant: 他們把東西都打包進箱子裡，

text: to make sure that things were easy to carry
into the van and also that they didn't get damaged.
zh: 放进车里，而且不会损坏。
zh_hant: 放進車裡，而且不會損壞。

text: And then they drove all of our stuff to my new house.
zh: 然后他们把东西都运到了新家。
zh_hant: 然後他們把東西都運到了新家。

text: Yeah.
Did you have any fragile bits?
So fragile means that it's easy to break,
zh: 易碎就是说很容易打碎，
zh_hant: 易碎就是說很容易打碎，

text: not very strong, plates and things.
zh: 不太结实，比如盘子什么的。
zh_hant: 不太結實，比如盤子什麼的。

text: Did you have?
Yes, those things had to be wrapped
and protected,
otherwise they would break.
Yes.
And did you have to move furniture as well?
zh: 那你是不是也得搬家具？
zh_hant: 那你是不是也得搬傢俱？

text: Yeah, we had to move sofas
and cupboards and wardrobes and heavy things like that.
zh: 还有柜子、衣柜这些重的东西。
zh_hant: 還有櫃子、衣櫃這些重的東西。

text: Yeah, does sound different to my experience, doesn't it.
zh: 嗯，听起来确实和我的经历不一样，是吧。
zh_hant: 嗯，聽起來確實和我的經歷不一樣，是吧。

text: I didn't have any furniture to take.
Do you find moving house exciting, scary?
zh: 你觉得搬家是兴奋，还是害怕？
zh_hant: 你覺得搬家是興奮，還是害怕？

text: How do you feel about moving house?
I think it's both.
It's exciting and scary.
It's exciting because this is going to be your new life,
zh: 兴奋是因为这会是你的新生活，
zh_hant: 興奮是因為這會是你的新生活，

text: or where your new life will happen,
zh: 或者你新生活开始的地方，
zh_hant: 或者你新生活開始的地方，

text: but it's also scary because you don't know what that's going to be like.
zh: 但也害怕，因为你不知道会是什么样。
zh_hant: 但也害怕，因為你不知道會是什麼樣。

text: You don't know what your neighbors are going to be like.
zh: 你不知道邻居会是什么样。
zh_hant: 你不知道鄰居會是什麼樣。

text: That's very true.
You don't know what your new friends are going to be like, yes.
zh: 你不知道新朋友会是什么样，对。
zh_hant: 你不知道新朋友會是什麼樣，對。

text: So there's lots of things that you don't know,
zh: 所以有很多未知的东西，
zh_hant: 所以有很多未知的東西，

text: and that's scary but also exciting.
zh: 那既让人害怕，也让人兴奋。
zh_hant: 那既讓人害怕，也讓人興奮。

text: Yeah, a lot of uncertainty for sure.
zh: 对，肯定有很多不确定性。
zh_hant: 對，肯定有很多不確定性。

text: Yeah, I think it can depend.
It depends if you're moving somewhere better or worse.
zh: 看你搬到的地方是更好还是更差。
zh_hant: 看你搬到的地方是更好還是更差。

text: But yeah, I was quite excited when I moved,
zh: 不过，我搬家那会儿挺兴奋的，
zh_hant: 不過，我搬家那會兒挺興奮的，

text: because I knew
that my new flat had a nice outdoor terrace.
zh: 我的新公寓有个很棒的露天阳台。
zh_hant: 我的新公寓有個很棒的露天陽臺。

text: As I said, we were close to parks and stuff, so I was excited.
zh: 就像我说的，离公园什么的也近，所以我挺期待。
zh_hant: 就像我說的，離公園什麼的也近，所以我挺期待。

text: So Georgie, if you are planning a move,
zh: 那乔吉，如果你打算搬家，
zh_hant: 那喬吉，如果你打算搬家，

text: what do you need to do to prepare?
Well, you need to do things
like setting up Wi-Fi in the new house,
other bills like electricity and heating, gas.
zh: 还有其他账单，比如电费、暖气、燃气。
zh_hant: 還有其他賬單，比如電費、暖氣、燃氣。

text: You need to put your name on the accounts.
zh: 你得把名字登记到账户上。
zh_hant: 你得把名字登記到賬戶上。

text: You need to plan what you're going to take.
So when you move,
it's a really good time to look at all of your possessions and think, what do I need?
zh: 正好可以看看自己的所有东西，想想：我需要什么？
zh_hant: 正好可以看看自己的所有東西，想想：我需要什麼？

text: Maybe I can get rid of stuff.
So throw stuff away.
Have you got any other ideas?
What else can you do to prepare for a move?
zh: 还有什么可以准备的呢？
zh_hant: 還有什麼可以準備的呢？

text: You can hire a removal company
or van if you're doing it yourself,
if you need to transport your stuff to your new house.
zh: 如果你需要把东西运到新家的话。
zh_hant: 如果你需要把東西運到新家的話。

text: Yeah, and you can't just use A taxi, yeah,
zh: 嗯，那你不能就打个出租车，嗯，
zh_hant: 嗯，那你不能就打個計程車，嗯，

text: sounds like a lot of work.
I don't want to move anytime soon.
zh: 我短时间内可不想搬家。
zh_hant: 我短時間內可不想搬家。

text: No, me neither.
No.
OK,
let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
zh: 咱们回顾一下对话里听到的词汇。
zh_hant: 咱們回顧一下對話裡聽到的詞彙。

text: We heard possessions, which are the things that you own or have.
zh: 咱们听到 possessions（物品），就是你拥有或有的东西。
zh_hant: 咱們聽到 possessions（物品），就是你擁有或有的東西。

text: For example, my phone and my clothes are my possessions.
zh: 比如，我的手机和衣服就是我的物品。
zh_hant: 比如，我的手機和衣服就是我的物品。

text: We talked about removal vans.
zh: 咱们聊到了 removal vans（搬家货车）。
zh_hant: 咱們聊到了 removal vans（搬家貨車）。

text: A removal van is a large vehicle
that people put your possessions into to go from one home
zh: 人们把东西放进去，从一个家搬到
zh_hant: 人們把東西放進去，從一個家搬到

text: to another.
And the company is called a removals company or removals firm.
zh: 这种公司叫 removals company 或 removals firm（搬家公司）。
zh_hant: 這種公司叫 removals company 或 removals firm（搬家公司）。

text: We heard packing,
and packing is where you put your own things into boxes
zh: 打包就是把东西放进箱子里，
zh_hant: 打包就是把東西放進箱子裡，

text: so that a removal firm can take them
zh: 这样搬家公司的工人才能把它们带到
zh_hant: 這樣搬家公司的工人才能把它們帶到

text: to your new home.
And we heard fragile.
zh: 咱们还听到了 fragile（易碎的）。
zh_hant: 咱們還聽到了 fragile（易碎的）。

text: is an adjective which describes something that can break easily,
zh: 这是个形容词，形容容易破的东西，
zh_hant: 這是個形容詞，形容容易破的東西，

text: for example, glass.
is fragile.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《简易英语》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《簡易英語》的全部內容。

text: Don't forget to test what you've learnt using the free worksheet on our website.
zh: 别忘了用咱们网站上的免费练习表测试一下你学到了什么。
zh_hant: 別忘了用咱們網站上的免費練習表測試一下你學到了什麼。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
We'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English.
zh: 下周我们会回来，继续用简易英语带来一段对话。
zh_hant: 下週我們會回來，繼續用簡易英語帶來一段對話。

text: Bye for now.
Goodbye.
